flux.text: Labour, materials, equipment, transport. 100% settled directly to the service provider / subcontractor.
Project management, AI orchestration, execution guarantee and dedicated end-to-end support.
Fully transparent service price (base cost + operational margin), inclusive of all applicable taxes.

escrow.text: funds are safely held in escrow and released to providers as each validated work milestone is completed.

de_verificat: Marja „+20–25%” se aplică peste costul de bază: înseamnă 16,7–20% din prețul final. În cele 2 comenzi reale marja a fost ~11% peste costul de bază (98 lei la 882 lei). Confirmați 20–25% ca țintă.
